title: Sales By Customer keeps or forgets its filter between visits as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role), with location A as your current location.
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, location A and location B, with location A's name first in A to Z order.
  • Make sure you are enrolled at both locations.
  • Make sure that before the release was installed, you did the steps below on Sales By Customer and noted whether the unticked location was still unticked when you came back.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • After the release is installed, open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In its Location filter, untick location B.
  2. Open A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  3. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) again from the Reports menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales By Customer narrows to location A.

Step 2:

  • A/R Summary opens.

Step 3:

  • Sales By Customer opens again.
  • Its Location filter is kept, or forgotten, exactly as you noted before the release.

Why: the six reports must not remember filters (they reuse the shared filter parts with that switched off); the other reports must keep doing whatever they did before (Rule 96, shared component).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §7 E2E, regression re-runs: “Regression re-runs (Keep, no edits expected) when Phase 1 lands, because it changes the shared filter kit, URL sync, useReportTableQuery and the location resolver:”

From: Developer verify task SV-11597 "A/R & A/P aging — verify Phase 1: shared report kit" (updated 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11597, Check: “Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress: filters, links shared from the address bar, and CSV/PDF exports behave exactly as before.”
